_about.use_case: UC3 - Excalibur batch snapshot reconciliation (Job 3 of 3)
_about.description: Reads the three Excalibur snapshot tables written by the Lakeflow Connect Oracle query-based connector ({{catalog}}.oracle_excalibur_batch.<table>) as BATCH table inputs -- they are MERGE-written (scd_type SCD_TYPE_1) and cannot be streamed -- recomputing {{catalog}}.staging.<table>_batch as a full snapshot on every update, reconciles each against its {{catalog}}.bronze CDC twin on primary key and compare columns inside this pipeline (pipeline_audit_only), and heals missing or drifted rows by appending them -- re-shaped by transform_sql into the exact Debezium/Zerobus envelope row the streaming lane consumes -- into the multiplexed CDC landing table {{catalog}}.staging.oracle_excalibur_cdc, so the 004 CDC engine applies the correction as an ordinary change event. Design and evidence: BT_Usecase/UC3/docs/UC3_MASTER_DOCUMENT.md.

WITH heal_params AS (
  SELECT current_timestamp() AS heal_ts,
         COALESCE(MAX(CAST(get_json_object(`value`, '$.payload.source.scn') AS DECIMAL(38,0))), 0) + 1 AS heal_scn
  FROM {{catalog}}.staging.oracle_excalibur_cdc
),
envelope AS (
  SELECT
    'oracdc-excalibur.EXCALIBUR.PHYSICAL_DEVICE' AS destination,
    '{{catalog}}.staging.oracle_excalibur_cdc' AS target_table,
    concat('{"schema":', '{"type":"struct","fields":[{"type":"double","optional":false,"field":"CUSTOMER_ID"},{"type":"string","optional":false,"field":"SUBSCRIBER_NO"},{"type":"string","optional":false,"field":"EQUIPMENT_NO"},{"type":"double","optional":false,"field":"PHY_SEQ_NO"}],"optional":false,"name":"oracdc-excalibur.EXCALIBUR.PHYSICAL_DEVICE.Key"}', ',"payload":',
